third_party/sentencepiece — PROVENANCE
=======================================

upstream_url:       https://github.com/google/sentencepiece
upstream_tag:       v0.2.2
upstream_head_sha:  e0cce7d37b065b5140349dbe12c6bcf6192fdd78
fetched_by:         git clone --depth=1 --branch v0.2.2 + rsync -a (exclusions below)

license:            Apache-2.0  (SPDX-Identifier: Apache-2.0; LICENSE at root)
fairness_notes:     docs/benchmark/fairness/bpe.md

scope
-----
Full vendored tree at tag v0.2.2, unmodified, minus:
  - .git/       (no in-tree git history)
  - .github/    (CI workflow YAML not needed for our build)
  - data/       (~42 MB of corpus samples and precompiled data used by upstream
                 tests and by SPM_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_DATA builds; we build with
                 the embedded data, so it is not needed)
  - python/     (Python bindings; not on the measured path; not built)
  - doc/        (Markdown documentation not consumed by our build)
  - benchmark/  (upstream benchmark programs; SPM_ENABLE_BENCHMARK=OFF)
  - contrib/    (optional NLCodec trainer; SPM_NLCODEC_BPE=OFF)

NOT linked into bpe_runner:
  - spm_train / spm_encode / spm_decode CLI binaries
  - Python bindings (excluded at vendoring time)
  - Unigram trainer subcommands (compiled into libsentencepiece because they
    share the trainer-spec scaffolding; not invoked by our runner)

build configuration (CMakeLists.txt at the repository root)
-----------------------------------------------------------
  SPM_ENABLE_SHARED=OFF, SPM_BUILD_TEST=OFF, SPM_ENABLE_TCMALLOC=OFF
  SPM_PROTOBUF_PROVIDER="internal"   bundled protobuf-lite (below)
  SPM_ABSL_PROVIDER="module"         Abseil fetched at configure time (below)

bundled snapshots (in-tree; no git submodules)
----------------------------------------------
  third_party/protobuf-lite/
    license:   BSD-3-Clause-Google (see third_party/protobuf-lite/LICENSE)
    contents:  minimal protobuf-lite runtime used for ModelProto serialization

  third_party/darts_clone/
    license:   BSD-2-Clause (see third_party/darts_clone/LICENSE)
    contents:  darts.h, the double-array trie used for vocabulary lookup

  third_party/esaxx/
    license:   MIT-style (see third_party/esaxx/LICENSE)
    contents:  esa.hxx + sais.hxx, the enhanced suffix array library

fetched at configure time (NOT in-tree)
---------------------------------------
  abseil-cpp
    upstream_url:   https://github.com/abseil/abseil-cpp
    upstream_tag:   20260526.0  (pinned by SentencePiece's own CMakeLists.txt)
    resolved_sha:   5650e9cf76d3be4318d5fa3af38ee483ddfd5e4a
    license:        Apache-2.0
    location:       third_party/sentencepiece/third_party/abseil-cpp/, plus a
                    symlink third_party/sentencepiece/third_party/absl; both
                    are created by SentencePiece's CMake and are git-ignored.

byte round-trip (load-bearing for the BPE baseline design)
----------------------------------------------------------
The harness does not feed raw bytes to SentencePiece. It drives SentencePiece
BPE through the GPT-2 byte<->unicode bijection (bytes_to_unicode + a
256-codepoint coverage line + character_coverage=1.0), which round-trips
arbitrary bytes (verified over 0x00..0xFF including lone 0x80/0xFF/NUL/newline
by the exhaustive fuzzer in tests/bpe_roundtrip_test.cpp). minbpe
(third_party/minbpe) serves as a secondary test-only round-trip cross-check.
Configuration rationale: docs/benchmark/fairness/bpe.md.

reproducibility
---------------
Double-anchored: tag `v0.2.2` plus the explicit HEAD SHA recorded above. The
per-file manifest is SHA256SUMS in this directory (every vendored file except
this record and the manifest itself).
